nodes.label: TenantContext
nodes.rationale: Resolves tenant only from the JWT box_id claim, never from request params; all box-scoped code in later milestones must resolve tenant via this class.

nodes.label: Design Law v1 (tokens only, warm-dark, race red)
nodes.rationale: Tokens-only enforcement, warm-dark default theme, race-red as sole accent, glow rationed to hover/live/focus — prevents ad hoc styling drift across screens; a raw hex outside the token file is a defect.
nodes.norm_label: design law v1 (tokens only, warm-dark, race red)

nodes.label: E2E Selector Preservation
nodes.rationale: Every restyle task swaps presentation only and preserves existing data-testid/selectors (input[name=email], login-error, member-search, etc.) so the M0/M1 e2e suite keeps passing through the visual overhaul.

nodes.label: Hibernate @TenantId ORM Isolation (ADR-001)
nodes.rationale: Adds ORM-level tenant filtering atop existing claim-based checks; tenant-agnostic queries must use NATIVE SQL because JPQL/derived queries are silently filtered to the caller's box.

nodes.label: RoleGuard.requireBoxAdmin
nodes.rationale: Single static guard for admin-only actions; all admin-only endpoints from M1 onward route through it to avoid inconsistent per-endpoint role checks.

nodes.label: BookingConcurrencyTest (no-oversell)
nodes.rationale: Two threads racing for the last spot must yield exactly one BOOKED + one WAITLIST; pessimistic FOR UPDATE row lock via findWithLockById serializes concurrent booking attempts.

nodes.label: V4 Schema (movement, benchmark_template, track, wod, program_slot)
nodes.norm_label: v4 schema (movement, benchmark_template, track, wod, program_slot)

nodes.label: Global Movement / Benchmark Catalog (non-tenant)
nodes.rationale: movement and benchmark_template are deliberately NOT @TenantId because global rows must be visible to every box; reads filter explicitly by box_id IS NULL OR box_id = :box instead.

nodes.label: runAsBox Synthetic Tenant Pattern
nodes.rationale: System writers of @TenantId entities (schedulers, background jobs) set a synthetic box tenant (JwtAuthenticationToken, SCOPE_box) before the transaction opens, since there is no inbound request to resolve TenantContext from.

nodes.label: WOD Score Self-Log (ScoreService/Controller)
nodes.rationale: membership_id is resolved from the caller's own JWT (userId+boxId), never accepted as a request param, so an athlete can only ever log a score against their own membership.

nodes.norm_label: v7 class model migration (session_item/template_piece, drops slot/track)

nodes.label: Design Law v2 (impeccable gate)
nodes.rationale: Binding from M5: type-scale/--tap/--scrim tokens only, every fetch has loading/error/empty, every save is pending+inline-error with input preserved, WCAG AA, bottom-tab shells + SaaS admin shell, bh-sheet overlays; every FE feature must pass an impeccable critique ≥28/40 with no open P0/P1 before merge.

nodes.label: Radius Token Scale (--r-ctl/--r-card/--r-lg/--r-full)
nodes.rationale: A single four-step radius scale drives roundness everywhere via --edge aliased to --r-ctl, so all ~79 existing var(--edge) reads pick up the rounder language automatically instead of hand-editing every call site.

nodes.label: SSE State Push (one SseEmitter per device)
nodes.norm_label: sse state push (one sseemitter per device)

nodes.label: runAsBox State Composition (TvStateService.compose)
nodes.rationale: A TV token has no SCOPE_box, so a tenant-less read of @TenantId entities would fail open to root and leak cross-box data; state composition must run inside runAsBox to set the synthetic box tenant first.

nodes.label: Orchestrator/Executor Process Model
nodes.rationale: Binding from M6: the main session (big model) orchestrates and gates (plan, review diffs, run tests, commit/merge); each task is dispatched to a Sonnet executor subagent with a self-contained brief; executors escalate rather than guess on ambiguity. Middle ground between M0/M1's slow per-task review loops and M2-M5.5's fully inline approach.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Timer
nodes.rationale: Timer state is persisted server-side; clients compute elapsed = pausedElapsedMs + (RUNNING ? now-startAtEpoch : 0) locally rather than the server streaming ticks, so the coach runner and every paired TV render the identical clock without drift from network jitter.

nodes.label: V11 Schema (auth_identity, email_token, refresh family cols)
nodes.norm_label: v11 schema (auth_identity, email_token, refresh family cols)

nodes.label: CookieBearerTokenResolver
nodes.rationale: JWTs move out of localStorage into httpOnly cookies (bh_at/bh_bt/bh_rt) behind a resolver that still honours Authorization: Bearer, so existing tests and the TV token flow keep working unchanged.

nodes.label: Refresh Token Family Reuse Detection
nodes.rationale: Refresh token rows are marked consumed rather than deleted; replaying a consumed token is evidence of theft, so the entire token family is revoked.

nodes.label: PasswordPolicy (HIBP k-anonymity check)
nodes.rationale: HIBP breach check fails open (allows the password through) if the external service is unreachable, prioritizing account-creation availability over strict rejection.
